notes.title: New Terrifying Horror Game DEMONOLOGIST Upcoming In March
notes.notes:
Dear Players! We're proud to announce Demonologist! A first-person horror ghost investigation & exorcism game. Created with the cutting-edge Unreal Engine 5 technology, the game will support Ray Tracing, HDR effect, 4K resolution, and make use of the Lumen system to offer the most immersive and visceral horror experience.
You will be able to talk to the ghost and the environment, develop your character and safe house and enjoy different experience in each game you play with your friends.

We invite you to join the new community on Steam. Add Demonologist to your wishlist today and stay up to date with the latest news about the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929610/Demonologist

notes.title: Haunt Chaser Major Update 1.3.0 PvE
notes.notes:
Hello there Dear Chasers,

Please check the list below for our most-anticipated PVE update and new features.

[olist]
[*] AI has been added in PvE mode. Now as a 4 person team you can be afraid of your heart's content against AI. Also, AI comes with 6 difficulty levels. Up to normal you can create a lobby freely. After that, you must finish the normal level to access HARD difficulty and so on for each difficulty level.
[*] The timer has been added to PvP mode as well. If you stay too long in a location, the entity can find you.
[*] Several bug and performance fixes
[*] Collision issues fixed
[*] Now you can change the movement keybindings
[/olist]

[b]For other requests and suggestions, do not hesitate to contact us via Discord or our community hub on Steam! Thank you![/b]

notes.title: 1.2.0 Haunt Chaser Update
notes.notes:
Tailor your Haunt Chaser Experience!

All you Chasers wanted lots of things, all of you have different tastes. So we decided to give you the chance of tailoring your Haunt Chaser PvP Experience how you like it!

Now, while Creating a Lobby you have a chance to customize your lobby with these options.

So, what are those settings?

1. You can set every Entity skill cooldown individually as you like.
2. You can set revive counts as you like.
3. You can set on or off Entities Haunting Voice for finding Chasers and cooldown as you like. (6 to 240 sec.)
4. You can set Proton Light Cooldown as you like.
5. Redesigned Interact UI.
